manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)); equal mean within each stratum (rival-doer, rival-done-to, adjunct-rival) and equally across strata; headline = maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable), lo/hi = tokenizer span. Comparator: same identity-adjacent careful English as the original (the proposal mapping IS the identity). File all finite outcomes once without tuning.
